blocks.text: Recent Netflix movies she was involved in include My Oxford Year, Roommates and Don’t Say Good Luck.
Kim joins Netflix VP Film Doug Belgrad who also is departing as part of the layoffs.

Before joining Netflix, Kim worked at STX and VP Development and subsequently SVP Production. During her tenure she worked on movies including The Edge of Seventeen , starring Hailee Steinfeld and Woody Harrelson; I Feel Pretty , starring Amy Schumer.

Prior to STX, Kim was Head of Development at 22 & Indiana Pictures, where she developed and executive produced the Clint Eastwood-Bradley Cooper hit American Sniper. She started out at Warner Bros and WME.
